changes2027.title: What changes in Korea in 2027 — pay, social insurance, welfare and labor
changes2027.subtitle: Minimum wage, social insurance, median income and labor rules changing in 2027, in date order and linked to calculators.

summary.label: What changes in your pay in 2027
summary.note: Insurance uses 2.8M KRW insured pay (3M minus 200k meals); take-home assumes 1 dependent and 200k non-taxable. The employment insurance proposal is excluded.

changes2027.share: 2027 minimum wage {wage} KRW; social insurance on 3M KRW pay rises {ins} KRW a month (ToolHub)

breakWaiver.title: 4-hour shifts can skip the break
breakWaiver.body: For 4 working hours, the 30-minute break can be skipped at the worker’s explicit request (Labor Standards Act Art. 54 proviso). The 1-hour break for 8 hours stays.

minWage.title: Minimum wage {wage} KRW per hour
minWage.body: That is {monthly} KRW a month at 40 hours a week (209 hours), up {diff} KRW ({pct}%) from 2026.
minWage.source: Ministry of Employment and Labor notice

pension.title: National pension {from} → {to}
pension.body: Employee and employer each pay {half}, rising 0.5%p a year to 13% by 2033.

longTermCare.title: Long-term care {from} → {to} of health premium
longTermCare.body: That is {income} of pay, decided on Oct 30, 2026.

health.title: Health insurance frozen at {rate}
health.body: The employee share stays {half}; deductions still rise with pay.
health.source: Health Insurance Policy Committee (Sep 8, 2026) — Kyongbuk Maeil

eiRate.title: Employment insurance {from} → {to} (proposal)
eiRate.body: A government plan from September 2026; the decree is not amended yet. If confirmed, each side pays 0.1%p more.

eiBasis.title: Employment insurance coverage by income, not hours
eiBasis.body: The exclusion based on working hours (such as under 15 hours a week) moves to an income basis, set by decree.

unemploymentFloor.title: Unemployment benefit at least {floor} KRW a day
unemploymentFloor.body: For job losses in 2027 the floor is 80% of minimum wage × 8 hours = {floor} KRW, above the {cap} KRW cap, so the floor is paid.

median.title: Standard median income up {pct}%
median.body: {four} KRW a month for a 4-person household and {one} KRW for one person, the largest rise since 2015. Welfare thresholds move with it.

livelihood.title: Livelihood benefit threshold {one} KRW (1 person)
livelihood.body: 32% of median income; {four} KRW for 4 people. Medical 40%, housing 48% and education 50% stay the same.

childAllowance.title: Child allowance under {from} → under {to}
childAllowance.body: Eligibility widens by one year each year until under 13 in 2030.

hourlyLeave.title: Annual leave in hourly units
hourlyLeave.body: Workers can request annual leave by the hour (new Art. 60(5)); units and limits are set by decree.

pensionCap.title: Pension income cap and floor updated
pensionCap.body: Announced every July; until then 6.59M KRW cap and 410k floor.

items.a: 10,700 KRW an hour, 2,236,300 KRW a month at 40 hours a week, up 380 KRW (3.7%) from 10,320 KRW.

items.q: Will more be deducted from pay in 2027?
items.a: Yes. Pension goes from 4.75% to 5% for employees and long-term care from 13.14% to 13.90% of the health premium. On 3M KRW pay, insurance rises 7,770 KRW a month; on a 50M KRW salary, take-home falls about 11,000 KRW a month.

items.q: What is the 2027 standard median income?
items.a: 6,929,885 KRW for 4 people and 2,736,042 KRW for one, up 6.70%. Livelihood thresholds are 875,533 KRW (1) and 2,217,563 KRW (4).

changes2027.asOf: Checked Nov 6, 2026. Items will be added when the government publishes its 2027 changes guide.
